question: Which of the following transports food, carbon dioxide and nitrogenous wastes in dissolved form ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plasma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The function of blood Plasma

__
 
• Plasma absorbs and transfers transports food, carbon dioxide, and nitrogenous wastes in dissolved form.
 
• Plasma also aids in the regulation of body temperature by absorbing and releasing heat as required.
 
• It is essential for maintaining electrolyte balance.
 
• It protects the body from infection and other blood problems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Blood Plasma: 

 
• Blood plasma is a yellowish liquid component of blood that suspends blood cells, proteins, and other components of blood.
 
• It accounts for around 55% of the body's total blood volume.
 
• It is made up of 92% of water by volume.
 
• It contains essential soluble proteins like albumins, globulins, and fibrinogen that constitute 6 to 8 %.
 
• Glucose, clotting factors, electrolytes like Na+, Ca2+, Mg2+, HCO3–, hormones, and carbon dioxide along with oxygen are also present in the blood plasma.
 
• Chemical buffers, the respiratory system, and the renal system all work together to keep the pH of extracellular fluid, including blood plasma, between 7.32 and 7.42.
 
• As the pH is greater than 7, blood plasma is said to be alkaline. 

So, the correct answer to this question is - **Plasma**.
